sensitivity_terminal: Signed perpetuity using inherited growth/ROIC/WACC assumptions

copper_curve.construction: log-linear matched-HG forward anchors at actual future delivery dates; last level held flat beyond observed support

dependence: rho=0 independent; +/-0.5 terminal Gaussian-score copula sensitivities, whole-path permutation preserving copper marginal paths; no estimated Brownian correlation

ops.source_table: Mine Statistics (Copper), three months ended June 30, physical page 8
ops.volume_basis: ALREADY_BARRICK_ATTRIBUTABLE; ownership retained as metadata, not multiplied again
ops.projection: Freeze Q2 sales and unit CoS at each mine for all forward quarters; explicit scenario assumption, not a mine forecast or company guidance
ops.rounding_note: Mine unit costs and kt volumes are rounded source values; weighted mine CoS need not equal reported total exactly. Capex components do not sum exactly to total because total includes other capitalized amounts.
ops.cash_flow_scope: CoS margin added before the common methodological tax/growth/ROIC transform; NOT reconciled EBITDA/FCFF. Capex and depreciation are source facts, not additional deductions in this margin experiment.
excluded_growth_projects: Lumwana Super Pit expansion incremental production and investment plan
limitations: Copper realized-price vs COMEX basis not estimated
Gold/copper dependence assumed independent, not estimated
Q/P bridge remains unvalidated
No full corporate equity bridge or per-share fair value
Mine reserves and closure obligations not modeled
Frozen gold operating-vector chronology inherited from baseline and not reforecast here

american_approximation.method: 600-step constant-volatility CRR futures IV, then equivalent Black-76 European bid/ask/mid
american_approximation.note: Tree discretization comparison; not an error bound on stochastic-model early exercise.

measure_contract.option_calibration_measure: Q: deterministic-rate European pricing approximation after American adjustment
measure_contract.operating_simulation_law: R: artificial conditional scenario law; neither validated P nor the option-pricing Q
measure_contract.physical_risk_premia: NOT_ESTIMATED: price, variance, jump intensity/marks and convenience yield
measure_contract.gold_scenario: GLD option-implied coefficients transferred to a separately dated realized-gold anchor and assumed drift; not a traded gold Q process
measure_contract.copper_scenario: Cross-delivery anchors imposed as a deterministic mean schedule; not the time drift of a fixed-delivery HG future
measure_contract.fixed_delivery_future_pricing_drift: ZERO under the deterministic-rate pricing convention; rates discount option premia
measure_contract.jump_compensation: lambda * (E[exp(J)] - 1), or left-step Hawkes intensity times that moment, under the simulated mark law
measure_contract.discount_law: Independent assumed WACC shocks; WACC is not the short rate or an estimated stochastic discount factor
measure_contract.q_cash_flows_plus_wacc: No corporate-pricing interpretation; may mix incompatible risk adjustments
measure_contract.numeraire_change: NONE; option normalization does not estimate physical probabilities
measure_contract.joint_commodity_measure: No common pricing kernel or joint P/Q law estimated; independence and terminal-score copulas are scenario assumptions
measure_contract.permitted_output: Conditional discounted operating proxy only; no physical probability, fair value or per-share target
